structures.compactionProposal: Pack all 14 bools into a 2-byte uint16_t bitmask; store access and paramModifier as 1-byte uint8_t enums.
Eliminate redundant rawText (synthesized on-demand from AST); pack 9 bools into 2-byte uint16_t typeQualifiers; narrow typeKind and modifier to uint8_t.
Pack 19 bools into 4-byte uint32_t flags; embed compacted SymbolModifiers (4 bytes); narrow typeKind to uint8_t.
Pack 6 return bools into 1-byte uint8_t returnQualifiers; embed compacted SymbolModifiers; benefit from nested ParameterInformation compaction.
Pack 3 return bools into 1-byte uint8_t qualifiers; embed compacted SymbolModifiers.
Pack 3 bools into 1-byte uint8_t flags; embed compacted SymbolModifiers (4 bytes).
Pack isHandleType and hasNullInitializer into 1-byte uint8_t flags; bundle line/column fields into SourceRange.
Pack ScopeKind enum and isFunctionScope boolean into a single 1-byte uint8_t header.
Pack isMixin into high bit of TSSymbol symbol id or pack 16-bit symbol with 8-bit flags.
Reorder members to eliminate 6 bytes of MSVC structure padding; pack m_symComment cleanly with pointers.
Pack isSynthesized and isPredefined into 1-byte uint8_t flags; optimize virtualFileUri SSO allocation; shrink std::variant footprint by compacting largest signature.
